attempts.summary: Repaired the node1 status writer. It now reloads message.conf on SIGHUP without restarting or duplicating the writer, rejects empty configuration while retaining the last valid message, exits cleanly on SIGTERM, and survives reboot. Existing journal entries were preserved. RHEL 9.8 and kernel 5.14.0-687.20.1.el9_8.x86_64 remain unchanged.
